prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption, redesign, finish, and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed for each kind of change.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Recovery Safeguard Notice: Adds a explicit hint notice on the sign-in screen informing users that logging into an existing account preserves their saved pets and desktop progress. (why: Support mail received 8 reports of pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Loading Status and Troubleshooting Info: Adds status indicators and explicit loading time estimates to the waiting screen before desktop pet launch. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a mean waiting time of 2336s, and 3 support tickets reported pet failing to appear on desktop.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Commands Intro Screen: Adds a dedicated quick commands screen right before completion showing basic shortcuts for summoning, hiding, and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Card Layout Redesign: Redesigns the story onboarding intro screen into a card-focused layout highlighting path options with visual choices. (why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating initial confusion about onboarding options.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pet Picker Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen to use a visual stage layout with clean pet preview cards. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89s.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Compact Sign-In Screen Layout: Switches the sign-in screen to a streamlined compact layout to ensure faster render times and prevent screen stalling. (why: Support received reports of the sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling before loading.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Welcome Guide Flow: Rebuilds home_intro with a tip carousel and progress checklist outlining essential pet behaviors before completion. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low (17.8%) and users experience confusion after onboarding regarding pet features.)
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Hint: Adds explicit formatting and quality hints to the photo upload screen during pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearances.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Generation Completion Notification: Enables system desktop notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting median time is 201s with a mean of 2336s, suggesting users minimize or abandon the window while waiting.)

scores.note: Addresses account recovery confusion reported in support via low-cost hint.
Targets high mean wait times (2336s) at home step and support loading tickets.

Redesign for choose_path lacks support ticket backing; redesigns tested negatively.
Adoption loses 39.1% of users, but redesigns show weak negative initial results.
Fixes technical stalling on sign-in screen reported in support mail.
Tackles 17.8% overall completion rate with interactive flow, requires release.
Config hint targets adoption (60.9% conversion) and photo upload support tickets.
System notifications mitigate window abandonment during long home wait times.
